_about: v75 (my drafts, for the lawyer's review): the candidate lines by role that come from the matter, not from a record of their own (src/rag/lawyer_method.py thesis_candidates). «matters»: a civil claim's matter by its article's place in the c.c. (range: first and last article); the attore's remedies, the convenuto's eccezioni -- each line offered on the claim record's elements. «penal_property»: the c.p. range of the offences against property, whose victim is offered sequestro and restituzione. v76: «fallback» -- the civil role's line when the record offers none (never the penal containment). v79.8 (B1): «actions» -- the matter's articles that confer an action (the norms that confer an action or ground the right the claim asserts -- 1062, 1158; a claim candidate is built only on one of them or on an institution module's: data/institution_modules.json). v79.10.1 (A2): «patterns» -- the institution words that name the matter as a family of the first read (lawyer_method.read_families): an article only a matter's «actions» admit is a claim only when its family (the module whose actions hold it, else its matter: lawyer_method.article_family) is one the first read's institutions name; where the institution has a module, only that module's (a sale or a custody article never leads a professional-liability case). «member_modules» -- the modules inside the matter's own family (custodia: 2051-2053 are special regimes of the fatti illeciti), whose articles the matter lists among its «actions»: a read naming the matter admits them; a typed contract's module (vendita, locazione, appalto, comodato, mutuo) is no member of «contratti» -- a contract read never makes a sale article a claim. My drafts, for the lawyer's review.
